gate.availability: At 3rd or 5th arrived waypoint for v051 runs, regardless of random encounter ID; both normal return and gate action visible
gate.nextDepthQuotePolicy: When guaranteed gate is available on projected arrival at depth 3 or 5 use minimum valid return fuel; all other depths use normal cost; every event fuel spend respects actual available escape cost
gate.legacyInProgress: Preserve original route/RNG/quoting for old in-progress voyages; activate on next new v051 departure
gate.acceptance: The selected cost is a candidate until real same-seed multi-ship economy and safety checks pass. No random disappearance of a gate already included in fuel reserve.

market.slotUse: Charge 1 when confirmed special quote/auction begins; do not reset by refresh, switching views, canceling quote, selling, or purchasing goods; reset only on next actual voyage return
market.afterLowOffer: Keep item and sell at ordinary fixed value, but the shared special trade opportunity is consumed
market.auction: Explicit up-front fee once, no refunds on no-sale; do not assume guaranteed profit
market.legacyOffers: Preserve existing active, sold, kept or noSale quotes and their UID rules; no free quota reset on schema migration
market.prices: Preserve existing baseline item values and current 0.5 marketplace odds pending isolated simulation

eggs.currentSource: Event attachment, not independent map node
eggs.visibility: Distinct short anomaly card and new-encounter arrived badge, show only after actual event
eggs.starterPityProposal: Within first two v051 voyages reaching depth 2, show an eligible unseen encounter OPTION and guarantee one compatible light egg; actual visit to the encounter remains the player's free choice. Never auto-select a route.
eggs.longRunPity: After consecutive eligible completed voyages with no egg, trigger one compatible egg at next valid arrival, without cash bonus
